source.title: Irish News, 17 May 1961, p. 7 ("Nominations for rural and county councils")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the full list of 21 unopposed nominations read in the Irish News of 17 May 1961, p. 7.

note: Triennial election of Coleraine Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. There was no contest: all 21 retiring members were returned unopposed, and the Irish News printed the full list of nominations by electoral division. Returned unopposed.
